body:
I can reproduce this issue in Godot 4.7.2.
My main PC uses an NVIDIA Quadro RTX 4000. I updated its NVIDIA driver about a month ago. Around the same time, I added a custom theme, so I initially suspected that the theme was causing the transparency.
I did not notice the issue immediately because the main application scene contains a full-window opaque panel and therefore appeared normal. The issue became apparent when running other scenes that do not contain a full-window opaque panel: those scenes appear semi-transparent.
Removing the custom theme or changing all its background colors to fully opaque does not affect the issue.
During interactive window resizing, the window repeatedly flashes transparent. This also affects the main application window, even though its full-window panel normally makes it appear opaque.
Relevant project settings:
```
display/window/per_pixel_transparency/allowed=true
display/window/size/transparent=false
rendering/viewport/transparent_background=false
```
I also tested the same project and Godot version on a laptop with an RTX 3060:
- NVIDIA driver 552.22 / Vulkan 1.3.277: affected in D3D12, but not Vulkan.
- NVIDIA driver 616.56 / Vulkan 1.4.351: affected in both D3D12 and Vulkan.
The Vulkan behavior changed after updating the driver on the same laptop.
